title: Testing documentation is stale relative to committed visual tests

evidence.quote: There is currently no committed automated test suite (`test`/`spec` files are not present).

reasoning: AGENTS.md still says no committed automated test suite exists, while the package exposes visual test scripts and committed Playwright specs are present. README.md also describes the current visual scope as homepage routes and full-page screenshots, but the committed tests include CV print layout, print behavior, and PDF checks. whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests validate rendered behavior, not consistency between repository documentation and the actual test suite.
